notes.title: Game is no longer available
notes.notes:
The game has officially been removed from the Steam store. Thanks for the few who have checked out the game. Those who received steam keys in the brief window after it's removal should have gotten the game by now. Any attempt at using a steam key will no longer work as the game's files have been removed.

Thank you for taking an interest in Magical Star Pillars and here's hoping the next game will be an improvement.

notes.title: Magical Star Pillars to be removed a week from now
notes.notes:
In a new incentive for Toolkitz, things have been changing drastically. I don't want to get too much into it as it is more of a personal thing and I do not like to share too much of my personal life, but I am aiming to change my life in 2020. Next year will be different as I attempt to go to the next level in promoting Child Arms but I found out that in order to do that, I have to change the way I live my life. I'm brushing away the old life I lived and embracing a new way of life, so I'm putting everything I have done since 2012 away. That was a part of an old life that had different plans and different philosophies but these no longer apply.

What I'm trying to say is by 2020, I'll be in a campaign to start over. I'll be changing both the way I make games and how I live my life, and that means that I have to put away all of my old work. Everything that I have done from 2012 is now archived, except for Magical Star Pillars. That was the last game I created under the old life I was living. After that game was released, a new way of life was slowly starting to mold.

With that said, Magical Star Pillars will be taken down from Steam on October 8. It was a great game to work on but I'll be honest, it's not the best that I can do and I'm somewhat embarrassed by it. This new outlook on life does not approve of the game, so I will feel much better if I take it down. So if you are still curious about the game, then you can still get it right now but you have one week left to do so.

To those who have gotten the game, I thank you for supporting me but consider it the "old" Toolkitz as we are now aiming to change our ways and the ways we make our games. However, this does not end MSP as there are plans for the game to be turned into a series and a sequel will be made, but unfortunately not in the near future. The sequel will hopefully represent a better product than the first game was always meant to be.

notes.title: The end and price drop
notes.notes:
Well, that's it. Magical Star Pillars is officially finished. The DLC is no longer available but as promised, the price has dropped so if you haven't gotten the game, well... you can do so now at your leisure as this price will never change for as long as the game is up.

I have more to say but it's mostly emotional, so I decided to post that somewhere else. You can find it on this link: 

https://www.indiedb.com/games/magical-star-pillars/news/farewell-magica-star-pillars

Let me just say that, as much as I loved making this game, it was hard at times. That is why MSP will be the last game I make by myself. Let this be the last game I make solo.

Thanks to all the reviewers out there who checked out my game, gave me valuable feedback, and even found things to praise about. I will always remember you generosity to this small indie developer.

notes.title: Last day for DLC
notes.notes: This is just a reminder that this is the last day for the DLC to be available. If you bought the game and haven't downloaded it yet, this is your last chance. If you haven't bought the game yet and do not care about the DLC, then wait until tomorrow for the price drop.

notes.title: Small update and price change
notes.notes:
I just made a very small update. Turns out that I forgot to add sounds to the new boss. This update adds them in but that is not the only change. If you have downloaded this DLC, you will notice that the ice is no longer slippery. That is because the code somehow got corrupted. When I went back to the ice level, for some reason, it did not react the same way as it did before. Then again, I always had trouble with the code for the ice since its very beginning. I overestimated coding this feature and in the end never got it right. That is the reason why there are only 2 stages with ice in them in the entire game. More stages were planned, including in the DLC, to have ice in the their stages but due to my inability to get it right, I had to make due with only 2. And now the code is corrupted and had no choice but to call it a lost cause and remove these feature. Now the ice performs the same as any other platform.

And with that, the game is officially finished. I won't be updating it anymore aside from some fixes that are reported but as far as development goes, the game is done. I'll have more to say later on after the 10th, which is the final day for the DLC to remain active. After the DLC is removed, the basic game will drop in price. Reviewers have praised the price for this game but to be honest, I've recently felt that it was too much, that is why I decided to lower it. So if you just want to play the game and don't care about extra content, then wait until after the 10th where the price will drop.

notes.title: DLC update and end of support
notes.notes:
A new update has been created for the DLC and this one fixes a few minor issues as well as unlocks an extra mission. Also, there may be a problem with the DLC not loading correctly. If you download the expansion, make sure the Loading screen is golden in color as oppose to white, there should be a new logo, and on the title menu, in the lower right corner, the version number should be present. If you can't see any of this, please contact me.

Also, the basic version has not been updated with the expansion's fixes so it is imperative that you download the DLC as the basic version will be fixed later on. It's free so there is no real reason not to.

This DLC is only available for a limited time. By the 10th, the DLC will be removed and this game's support will finally end.

notes.title: DLC update on artwork
notes.notes:
The artwork for the current expansion's cutscenes have been patched. It is no longer a flat solid color but actually complete. There's still much to do however so another patch will be made in the coming weeks.

Be sure to get this DLC by October 10th as it is limited time only. When the 10th arrives, it will no longer be available.

notes.title: DLC released, issues, and time limit
notes.notes:
After months of working on it, the free DLC for Magical Star Pillars has arrived!

This expansion includes all the material that was suppose to be available in the basic version but could not be implemented due to time constraints and had to resort to releasing the story mode only. This new expansion contains more features which include a new quest, more levels, and unlockable behind the scenes look at the making of the game.

To access all these features, you'll have to complete the basic game by finishing all the stages. Once you do, you'll receive a message saying you've unlocked the expansion.

However be aware that this is a limited time only DLC as it will only be available for a month. This is because this was made to commemorate the 5th anniversary of Toolkitz and there's only a month left before we enter the 6th. When that time comes, the DLC will be removed and MSP will finally end support. So get it while you still can. It's absolutely free so if you got the game, there's no reason not to.

There is also something else you must know. By the last week I was running out of time and I could not finish the artwork and some crucial material. The game is playable, all unlockables are available to find, and the expansion's story lines are complete, but there still some things that need to be fixed and the art for the cutscenes are in a unfinished state. I will be working on fixing these in the coming weeks and will soon upload an update. Please be patient while we fix these issues. There will also be an extra secret for you to find as a compensation for your patience.

notes.title: DLC progress and reviews
notes.notes:
I would like to thank all who have played the game and those who have reviewed it. Over the past weeks while the DLC is being developed, we have been contacting many review sites and have gotten positive feedback on the game, with the gameplay being the most praised. That's not to say we have not gotten some critiques. One of the biggest complaints is the map is hard to navigate through corridors, mainly in Clay Island. We are working on fixing this issue as well as many others that have been pointed out to us so expect an update in the near future. Overall the game has been lauded as being enjoyable and charming, and I'm thankful for everyone who has given us such honest feedback.

As for the DLC's progress, it appears that there is a lot more that is needed to add that the original expected development of 2 months will not be enough time to do so. We have to extend the time by 3 additional months and we are expecting the DLC to be finished by early September. I apologize for this delay but we are adding more content to the game that will require such a large amount of development hours. If you are wondering what will go into the DLC, here is a list of the additional features:

- A new storyline with an additional 20 extra stages strung out throughout the previous islands.
- A new island, Gold Island, with an extra boss.
- An extra storyline where you can unlock 3 more characters.
- Unlockable development extras such as concept art and trivia.
- Coin challenge where you must find every coin in every level.

There is also one more extra feature but I want to see if you guys can find it, so I hope you look forward to the DLC coming in a few months.

notes.title: Gamepad support now enabled and update on DLC progress
notes.notes:
Just a quick announcement. The game has been updated to include gamepad support. You can now plug in a controller and the game will detect it. With this update, I had to add a fail safe due to being able to get stuck on the main menu if you needed to use a gamepad but did not have one. You can now revert to the default control scheme by holding F5 for 2 seconds. The button configuration menu has also been changed for ease of use. You no longer have to configure each button one by one. Now you have to press the Restart button in the menu and you will go through the entire list one by one. This is a better option due to the original setup having you edit the button with the controller but go through the menu with the keyboard. Now you only have to use the keyboard to access the menu and start the configuration process.

The DLC is now in production. I mentioned that it will take 2 months to finish it but this date is being upped by a few extra weeks. I am aiming to release this in 2 months and 2 weeks but there is no guarantee of that. All I can say is that the DLC will arrive before August comes around.

notes.title: Controller support coming and about the demo's save feature
notes.notes:
The issue with controller support has been detected and fixed. However, testing needs to be done to ensure that it is compatible with different controllers. This means the update to the game won't be uploaded juts yet. There may have to be a review process as well for the new build so I'm going to say that controller support will be implemented next week so please be patient while we get things sorted out.

Also, the demo was removed but it has been advised to return it for any potential customer desiring to try the game out first. The reason for it's removal was because the demo can save your progress but this save file is now incompatible with the full release of the game, meaning you cannot pick up the game where you left off in the demo. A new demo will be implemented to remove the save feature so for now the old demo will remain. Just be aware that you cannot continue your game where the demo leaves off.

notes.title: Game released and controller support issues
notes.notes:
I would like to apologize as this game was intended to release 2 days ago but there were delays in the QA and review process. I spent the last few days working non-stop to get this game out and finally managed to but there was one thing that hindered my progress and had to remove and that was gamepad support.

On the last hours of getting this game ready, controller support seemed to seize functioning. I have yet to discover what the cause of this is and I could not figure it out on time. We'll be looking into this issue and we'll update you guys when it's been fixed.

There is also free DLC planned that will begin production next week that will contain all the features that I wanted to add but could not due to time restraints. The DLC will contain extra levels that will be more challenging than the ones present in the normal game along with some unlockable extras such as concept art and development trivia that will be a behind the scenes look at the development of the game. It will be available in two months time but an exact date has not been decided.

That's all that I have to say and I hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Release date coming late spring, Extended Demo available by request
notes.notes:
Thank you all for visiting the MSP store page on Steam. This game has been worked on a little over a year and I am happy to announce that it will soon be released coming late spring. However, there are some things that I must mention.

First off, I would like to introduce myself. My name is Juan and I have been working on this game all by myself with most of the assets in the game created by me. I have been making games under the Toolkitz brand for 5 years and in those 5 years, I have learned that making games by yourself is not only very difficult but in the end not as worth as working with others. That is why this will be the final game in my so called "Solitary Years" as my next project will aim to work with others.

Second, the release date is late spring but I am aiming for an April release. However, all the content I wanted to add into the game cannot be included by that deadline so that is why I decided to release a Story only version of the game come this April. This version of the game is just the storyline and some extra levels. This is the basic game but there will be an upcoming expansion that includes extra goodies such as concept art and early game footage to unlock along with some special surprises. I figured since this stuff is just extra, it isn't really required for the storyline to be enjoyed. This extra content will take an additional 2 months so I figured I can offer them for later down the line as free DLC.

Lastly, this game is currently in a demo state so feel free to download it and provide feedback. However, if you wish to review the game or provide a playthrough of it, there is a special Extended edition that includes more levels than what is in the demo. If you are interested in getting more content and are a reviewer or have a channel, then please contact me.

That is all I have to say right now. There will be updates until the release of the game so please keep an eye on this project and thank you for visiting the store.
